verses.text: Jacob heard there was grain in Egypt and asked his sons, “Why are you just standing there looking at each other?” 👀
He said, “I heard Egypt has grain. Go down and buy some for us, so we can stay alive instead of starving.” 🌾
So Joseph’s ten brothers went down to Egypt to buy grain. 🧭
Jacob didn’t send Benjamin, Joseph’s brother, with them. He was afraid something might happen to him. 🛑
Israel’s sons joined the crowd going to buy grain, because famine had reached Canaan too. 🌾
Joseph governed the land and sold grain to everyone there. His brothers came and bowed low before him, faces to the ground. 🙇
Joseph recognized his brothers, but played stranger and spoke sharply. “Where did you come from?” he asked. “From Canaan,” they said, “to buy food.” 🎭
Joseph knew who his brothers were, but they didn’t recognize him. 👀
Then Joseph remembered his dreams about them and said, “You’re spies! You’ve come to find the land’s weak spots.” 🕵️
They said, “No, my lord. Your servants came only to buy food. 🙏
“We’re all one man’s sons. We’re honest men; your servants aren’t spies.” 🗣️
Joseph said, “No. You came to scout the land’s weak spots.” 🕵️
They said, “Your servants are twelve brothers, all sons of one man in Canaan. The youngest is with our father today, and one brother is gone.” 👨‍👦
Joseph said, “Just as I told you: you’re spies. ⚠️
“Here’s how I’ll test your story: by Pharaoh’s life, you won’t leave unless your youngest brother comes here. 👑
“One of you can go bring your brother back. The rest will be held while I test whether you’re telling the truth. Otherwise, by Pharaoh’s life, you’re spies.” ⚖️
Joseph put them all in custody for three days. ⛓️
On the third day, Joseph told them, “Do this and you’ll live. I fear God. 🙏
“If you’re honest men, let one brother stay locked up here. The rest of you can take grain home for your starving families. 🌾
“Bring your youngest brother to me. Then your story will be confirmed, and you won’t die.” They agreed. 🤝
They said to each other, “We’re paying for what we did to our brother. We saw how distressed he was when he begged us, but we wouldn’t listen. Now this trouble has caught up with us.” 💔
Reuben answered, “Didn’t I tell you not to sin against the boy? You wouldn’t listen. Now his blood is being demanded.” ⚖️
They didn’t know Joseph understood them, because an interpreter was speaking between them. 🗣️
Joseph turned away and wept. Then he came back, spoke with them, and took Simeon from among them, binding him while they watched. 😢
Joseph ordered his servants to fill their sacks with grain, return each man’s money to his sack, and give them supplies for the journey. They did exactly that. 🎒
The brothers loaded the grain onto their donkeys and left. 🫏
At the overnight stop, one brother opened his sack to feed his donkey and spotted his money right at the sack’s opening. 💰
“My money’s been put back! It’s right here in my sack!” he told his brothers. Their hearts sank. Trembling, they asked each other, “What has God done to us?” 😨
They reached their father Jacob in Canaan and told him everything that had happened. 🏠
“The man who rules that land spoke harshly to us and accused us of spying. 🗣️
“We told him, ‘We’re honest men. We’re not spies. 🙋
“‘We’re twelve brothers, sons of our father. One is gone, and the youngest is with our father in Canaan.’ 👨‍👦
“‘The man who rules that land told us, “This is how I’ll know you’re honest: leave one brother with me, take grain home for your starving families, and go. 📜
“‘“Bring your youngest brother to me. Then I’ll know you aren’t spies but honest men. I’ll return your brother, and you’ll be free to trade in the land.”’” 🧭
As they emptied their sacks, every man found his bundle of money inside. When they and their father saw the money, they were afraid. 💰
Jacob their father said, “You’ve taken my children from me! Joseph is gone, Simeon is gone, and now you want to take Benjamin too. Everything is turning against me.” 💔
Reuben told his father, “You can put my two sons to death if I don’t bring him back. Place Benjamin in my care, and I’ll return him to you.” 🙋
Jacob said, “My son isn’t going down with you. His brother is dead, and he’s all I have left. If harm comes to him on your journey, you’ll bring my gray head down to Sheol in sorrow.” 🕯️
